description: List product orders whose status changed since a time (default: last 24h) — new payments, cancellations, returns — then optionally fetch details. 변경된 상품주문 내역을 조회합니다. Use for 'any new orders?' questions. Needs nothing; lastChangedFrom optional (ISO 8601).

lastChangedFrom.description: ISO 8601 datetime; default = 24 hours ago. Max range 24h per call.

lastChangedType.description: Filter by change type, e.g. PAYED for newly paid orders

withDetails.description: Also fetch order details (buyer, product, amounts) for the returned productOrderIds

name: naver_list_orders
